    Class LedonWebTestHost

    集成测试宿主：一行搭建 TestServer + HttpClient，省掉每个测试重复的 CreateBuilder/UseTestServer/Build/StartAsync 样板。

    await using var host = LedonWebTestHost.Create(builder => builder.AddLedonWeb());
var body = await host.Client.GetStringAsync("/hello");
